chapter: Parker, Buster Smith and the Kansas City style
title: Lester Young's influence on Bird and Buster Smith's role
summary: Armstrong influenced Lester, Lester influenced Bird, and Buster Smith made the Basie band.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: But you think Lester was a strong influence.

Oh, definitely. You know, if I might say, the influences as they flow -- Louis Armstrong was the influence on Lester Young. Lester Young was an influence on lots of saxophone players and Billie Holiday. You can see that same meaningful sound in what they did. And although one famous writer says that Bird told him he was not influenced by Lester Young, if you listen to him, you can tell that he was completely influenced by him.
And of course Buster Smith was the one that actually made that Basie band, as quiet as its kept.
